13. (Currently amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides __integrated contact elements positioned externally on said second portion__ by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater.

14. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising __an insulating sheathing body that is distinct from and does not form part of said second connector__.

15. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __and does not enclose said second connector__.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __and the heater is integrated into the flexible tube rather than the sheathing body__.

18. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube __with the heater positioned within the tube walls__.

19. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube __and not into the sheathing body__.

20. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes __a separate__ pressure measuring tube connection __that is distinct from the respiratory gas passage__.

21. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising __an external__ respiratory gas humidifier __that is separate from the tube arrangement__.

22. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line __independent of the tube arrangement__.

23. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece __with integrated heating capability__ disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube.

24. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __with internal heater elements__.

25. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __positioned within the tube structure__.

26. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage __and is positioned on the external second portion__ such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

27. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

28. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __with said contact elements integrated into said outwardly extending second portion__.

29. (Currently amended) A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides __integrated contact elements positioned externally on said second portion__ by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

30. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

31. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __with said contact elements integrated into said outwardly extending second portion__.
